postings.title: Senior Backend Engineer
highlights: Senior Backend Engineer (Python/AWS) - real-time data product, global clients

postings.summary: A senior backend role on a real-time data product with global clients. The listing describes owning the async pipelines and the AWS infrastructure behind them — queues and workers — as well as the serving layer. Listed at $160,000 - $180,000 p.a., full time, hybrid in Sydney CBD.
postings.matchReason: Backend engineering in Sydney on Python and AWS, hybrid, at the seniority the criteria ask for.
